|game_text=Deploy on a Dagobah site. Target a mentor here. Also, target or deploy (regardless of location deployment restrictions) an apprentice here. Attempt when targets are present at the beginning of your control phase. Draw training destiny. If destiny + apprentice's ability &gt; 12, test completed: Place on apprentice. All opponent's Force drain bonuses are canceled. Mentor: One of your characters of ability &gt; 2. Apprentice: One of your non-droid, non-Jedi characters of lesser ability than mentor. Each time you complete any Jedi Test, you may exchange one card in hand for one Jedi Test in your Lost Pile.

|notes=* Decipher published this errata as text in the [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]] (29 January 2002). The main image is that entry. Printed face: [[Great Warrior]]. Side-by-side faces: [[Errata]].
* Decipher's Glossary Supplement revises only the last line of the test: “{Place} on apprentice. All opponent's Force drain bonuses are canceled.” The rest of the text here is the printed card's.
* No black-bordered card prints exactly these words: from the 2013 slip on, the Players Committee's cards (latest [[Great Warrior (PC 2023 D-E1 card)]]) say “Mentor: Your character of ability > 2. Apprentice: Your non-droid, non-Jedi character…” where Decipher's card says “One of your characters” and “One of your non-droid, non-Jedi characters”.

|rulings=* May be used to deploy an apprentice to Dagobah (ignoring Dagobah rules).
* If [[I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee]] returns either [[Great Warrior]] or the apprentice deployed by [[Great Warrior]], both cards are returned to hand together.
* Only cancels Force drain bonuses that come from DS cards affecting DS Force drains.
* For example, if DS Force drains at the LS system [[Tibrin]], the +1 bonus in [[Tibrin]]'s game text is not canceled because it is a LS card.
* For example, if LS Force drains at the DS site [[Cloud City: Interrogation Room]], the +1 bonus in the site's game text is not canceled because it is a LS Force drain.

Decipher's own errata for this card, published as text in the Glossary Supplement (29 January 2002). Decipher never printed a card with this wording.
